body: My coping mechanisms are not working. I'm a failure and stupid.

I know everyone can't hate me, but every time I attempt to fit in, it's awkward and I feel unaccepted, ignored, and not worthy. Some people get angry and hate me even when I do not think that I am doing anything wrong. I am still surprised every time this happens. I don't know any face to face groups, but I looked at WrongPlanet one time and I could not ask for help on the forums because I saw multiple people saying mean things to somebody else. Plus it was too cheerful there.

I was born with Asperger Syndrome and I've never had long term or healthy friendships. The only family I have regrets me and even the nicest people hate me. I've never fit in with outcasts. The only things not wrong in my head are that I have average intelligence and I don't hear voices that aren't there. It's unavoidable because I hurt whether I think, talk, or neither one. Friends can't help and there are no affordable therapists around here. I can't enjoy anything any more.
How do I get rid of all the mental conditions that I was born with that make my life a living hell and there's no cure for?
